# Asteroid Dodge

A simple HTML canvas game where the player moves a ship horizontally at the bottom of the screen to dodge falling asteroids. Asteroids spawn at random positions and fall faster over time. The player loses when the ship collides with any asteroid. Score increases with each asteroid avoided.

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Assumes an HTML <canvas id="game"></canvas> exists.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7: 
8:   // Set canvas size (fallback to 800x600 if not set via CSS)
9:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
10:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
11: 
12:   // Preload sounds (ensure files exist in the same directory)
13:   const sounds = {
14:     dodge: new Audio('dodge.wav'),
15:     crash: new Audio('crash.wav'),
16:   };
17: 
18:   // Starfield background
19:   const starCount = 100;
20:   const stars = [];
21:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
22:     stars.push({
23:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
24:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
25:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
26:     });
27:   }
28: 
29:   // Ship definition
30:   const ship = {
31:     width: 40,
32:     height: 20,
33:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
34:     y: canvas.height - 30,
35:     speed: 5,
36:     movingLeft: false,
37:     movingRight: false,
38:   };
39: 
40:   // Asteroid definition
41:   const asteroids = [];
42:   let asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
43:   let lastSpawn = 0;
44:   let asteroidSpeed = 2; // initial fall speed, will increase over time
45: 
46:   let score = 0;
47:   let gameOver = false;
48: 
49:   // Input handling
50:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
51:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') ship.movingLeft = true;
52:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.movingRight = true;
53:   });
54:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
55:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') ship.movingLeft = false;
56:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.movingRight = false;
57:   });
58: 
59:   function spawnAsteroid() {
60:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
61:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - radius * 2) + radius;
62:     const angle = 0;
63:     const rotationSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05; // random rotation
64:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed: asteroidSpeed, angle, rotationSpeed });
65:   }
66: 
67:   function update(dt) {
68:     // Move ship
69:     if (ship.movingLeft) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
70:     if (ship.movingRight) ship.x = Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x + ship.speed);
71: 
72:     // Update starfield for parallax effect
73:     for (const s of stars) {
74:       s.y += 0.3; // slow downward drift
75:       if (s.y > canvas.height) {
76:         s.y = 0;
77:         s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
78:       }
79:     }
80: 
81:     // Spawn asteroids based on interval
82:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
83:       spawnAsteroid();
84:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
85:       // Gradually increase difficulty
86:       asteroidSpeed += 0.05;
87:       asteroidSpawnInterval = Math.max(300, asteroidSpawnInterval - 10);
88:     }
89: 
90:     // Update asteroids
91:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
92:       const a = asteroids[i];
93:       a.y += a.speed;
94:       // Remove if off screen
95:         if (a.y - a.radius > canvas.height) {
96:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
97:           score++;
98:           // Play dodge sound on successful avoidance
99:           sounds.dodge.currentTime = 0;
100:           sounds.dodge.play();
101:         }
102: 
103:     }
104: 
105:     // Collision detection
106:     for (const a of asteroids) {
107:       const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height };
108:       const distX = Math.abs(a.x - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w / 2));
109:       const distY = Math.abs(a.y - (shipRect.y + shipRect.h / 2));
110: 
111:         if (distX <= shipRect.w / 2 + a.radius && distY <= shipRect.h / 2 + a.radius) {
112:           // Simple AABB-circle hit test
113:           gameOver = true;
114:           // Play crash sound on collision
115:           sounds.crash.currentTime = 0;
116:           sounds.crash.play();
117:           break;
118:         }
119:     }
120:   }
121: 
122:   function draw() {
123:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
124: 
125:     // Draw stars (background)
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
127:     for (const s of stars) {
128:       ctx.beginPath();
129:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
130:       ctx.fill();
131:     }
132: 
133:     // Draw ship (simple triangle)
134:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
135:     ctx.beginPath();
136:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.width / 2, ship.y);
137:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
138:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
139:     ctx.closePath();
140:     ctx.fill();
141: 
142:     // Draw asteroids with radial gradient and rotation
143:     for (const a of asteroids) {
144:       // Update rotation angle
145:       a.angle += a.rotationSpeed;
146:       ctx.save();
147:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
148:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
149:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.radius * 0.2, 0, 0, a.radius);
150:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ddd');
151:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
152:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
153:       ctx.beginPath();
154:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
155:       ctx.fill();
156:       ctx.restore();
157:     }
158: 
159:     // Draw score
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
161:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
162:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
163: 
164:     // Game over overlay
165:     if (gameOver) {
166:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
167:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
168:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
169:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
170:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
171:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
172:     }
173:   }
174: 
175:   let lastTime = 0;
176:   function loop(timestamp) {
177:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
178:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
179:     lastTime = timestamp;
180: 
181:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
182:     draw();
183: 
184:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
185:   }
186: 
187:   // Start the loop
188:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
189: })();

(End of file - total 189 lines)
</content>
